correctness.rationale: Proof classifies all full-trace ball configurations. Every triple type has explicit witnesses for full, three pairs, three singletons and empty; exceptions q=2,d=2 and q=3,d=2 are derived by absent empty witnesses. Unique covering centers justify exact counts. Any four points in one ball either have a collinear triple or a three-point subset coverable only at the common center, ruling out shattering. Exhaustive finite checks across eleven grids and partial checks on a twelfth agree (859801 supports).

evidence: Coudert et al. 2024 define graph VC dimension from all closed neighborhoods and give a general computation algorithm, not coefficients for H(d,q). Housholder et al. 2025 use n(x), the open neighborhoods on induced subsets, with separate extremal subset-size bounds.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither a generic algorithm nor the sufficient induced-subgraph size bounds determines the number and precise types of closed-neighborhood-shattered supports in all Hamming graphs.
